note: Set A correctly attributes most claims to their specific details (A1, A3, A5, C3), whereas Set B frequently misattributes PV Post details (A1, e.g., 2" TYP, 3" TYP) to Crane Attachments. Set B also misidentifies plate thickness as weld size (3/8") and contains excessive redundant claims. Set A has minor errors, such as attributing the 1/2" plate to Detail A5 instead of A3, but is overall more faithful and precise.
